acceptance_hypotheses: Both inputs import, exactly roundtrip all authored populated column names/types and cell values, calculate and export usable logs and reports with zero converter errors under guarded session-0 SSH execution.

At the h24 CAL24 opportunity, native events show BASE-01 to BASE-02 and return travel under both arms, with longer outbound and return legs in the pm_specific arm corresponding to its one-hour route values rather than the generic quarter-hour link. CAL24 work occurs at BASE-02 in both arms and completes before each aircraft returns.

All PM and mission event outcomes reconcile with report PM, system and resource bins and terminal readiness in both arms. Any interaction with the linked BIG24P75 task is retained as observed, without a general preemption claim.
gate: Publish only if both frozen inputs and the guarded native closure are intact, exact authored-cell roundtrips and a separate independent event/report replay pass, both travel legs physically distinguish default from PMID-specific route, and the D12 parent event baseline remains attributable. Otherwise retain a diagnostic and freeze a new version.
